insights.claim: The neutrino fog provides a natural stopping point that answers complaints about endlessly lowering cross-section targets.
The field oversold WIMPs as the obvious dark matter answer for decades.
Octopus arm autonomy is better described as sophisticated reflex control than independent thinking.
Octopus hierarchical control resembles robots offloading low-level motor control to their joints.
If the octopus brain does not precisely track its arms, its body awareness differs fundamentally from ours.
Hippocampal replay causally supports memory rather than being a side effect of sleep activity.
Backward replay may propagate reward to earlier path steps, analogous to reinforcement learning credit assignment.
Proof-of-stake addresses Sybil resistance, not the Byzantine generals problem, which classic BFT protocols already solve.
Stake concentrating in exchanges and pools makes the one-third-of-stake assumption the real vulnerability.
Self-healing lime clasts matter for modern concrete mainly by keeping water out to protect rebar, not structural strength.
Cost or curing time likely hinders commercial adoption of hot-mixed lime concrete.
The mother tree framing anthropomorphises fungi that move resources according to their own interests.
A convincing test must confirm one fungal network links two trees and trace label through only that link.
Children do the heavy lifting in turning a messy pidgin into a creole with consistent grammar.
Many children with little access to the colonial language should produce more child-driven grammatical innovation.
Observing a language emerge in real time is the cleanest test of child-driven regularisation.
Biofouling on tidal turbine blades matters more to performance and cost than is commonly admitted.
Designing roughness-tolerant blades is smarter than biocide coatings that harm marine environments and erode in high flow.
Instant runoff's monotonicity failure is its most troubling flaw because it is so counterintuitive to voters.
If redesigning elections, Condorcet or cardinal methods may be preferable to instant runoff, which still beats plurality.
Permafrost methane is neither a ticking bomb nor negligible; the truth lies between these framings.
Abrupt thaw processes like thermokarst lakes are poorly represented in models, making uncertainty enormous.
Sparse Arctic flux measurements are the biggest obstacle to constraining permafrost methane emissions.

adjacent_ideas.claim: Stake-weighted validator governance may inherit social choice pathologies like monotonicity failures in coalition decisions.
Distributed octopus arm controllers might rely on local offline replay for credit assignment without central tracking.
Self-healing mineral chemistry could inspire turbine coatings that repair erosion damage from high-flow sediment.
Both dark matter searches and Arctic methane monitoring hit limits where background signals swamp sparse measurements.
